# SmartNShine — AI-Powered ATS Resume Builder, Developer Portfolio Maker & AI Career Platform

> SmartNShine (https://www.smartnshine.in) is an all-in-one AI career platform engineered to produce 95+ ATS-compliant resumes with a 98% recruiter pass rate, generate interactive 3D developer portfolios from GitHub in 60 seconds, and simulate real-time AI voice mock interviews.

## Core Capabilities
- **ATS Resume Builder & Optimizer**: Real-time ATS scoring, keyword matching against job descriptions, and instant parsing validation for Taleo, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, and iCIMS.
- **Interactive Developer Portfolio Maker**: Generates live, hosted portfolios with interactive 3D tech stacks, GitHub project integration, experience timelines, and custom shareable URLs.
- **AI Bullet Point Optimizer (OpenAI GPT-4o)**: Generates quantifiable, metric-driven resume bullet points with powerful action verbs tailored to target positions.
- **AI Voice Mock Interview Coach**: Real-time voice and technical interview practice tailored to specific job roles and seniority levels.
- **Real-time ATS Resume Score Analyzer**: Scans existing resumes against job descriptions for instant keyword gap analysis.
- **1-Click Pixel-Perfect PDF Export**: High-resolution vector PDF downloads formatted to parse cleanly without truncation.

## Interactive Portfolio Templates
- [Tech Developer Portfolio](https://www.smartnshine.in/tech-portfolio): Dark-mode interactive 3D developer portfolio with GitHub repository showcase, live demos, and terminal contact form.
- [SmartNShine Executive Portfolio](https://www.smartnshine.in/smartnshine-portfolio): Polished executive portfolio template with verified skill badges, experience timeline, and ATS resume download.
- [Magazine Editorial Portfolio](https://www.smartnshine.in/magazine-portfolio): High-aesthetic editorial layout designed for Creative Directors, Technical Writers, and Product Designers.

## ATS Resume Template Catalog
- [Classic Template](https://www.smartnshine.in/templates?template=classic): Traditional serif design with clear hierarchy (99% ATS pass score). Best for Corporate, Law, Finance, and Academia.
- [Modern Template](https://www.smartnshine.in/templates?template=modern): Contemporary two-column layout with sidebar and high visual appeal (98% ATS score). Best for Product Managers, Marketing, and Operations.
- [Minimal Template](https://www.smartnshine.in/templates?template=minimal): Ultra-clean black & white single-column design with maximum ATS compatibility (99% score). Best for all roles and freshers.
- [Tech Stack Developer](https://www.smartnshine.in/templates?template=tech): Developer-focused layout highlighting technical skills, GitHub repositories, and system architecture projects (98% ATS score).
- [Professional Elite](https://www.smartnshine.in/templates?template=professional): Balanced and structured corporate format engineered for enterprise and mid-to-senior level roles.
- [Strategic Leader](https://www.smartnshine.in/templates?template=strategic-leader): Executive layout highlighting business metrics, revenue growth, and team leadership.
- [Impact Pro](https://www.smartnshine.in/templates?template=impact-pro): Metrics-first format emphasizing quantifiable achievements and ROI.
- [GitHub Style](https://www.smartnshine.in/templates?template=github-style): Developer portfolio-integrated resume format for open-source contributors and software engineers.
